title: Study appraisal
summary: Appraises ONE study: it names the study by exactly one cited source fragment and records what that study reported and how it was conducted, domain by domain. It never rates a body of evidence: certainty across studies is an EvidenceSynthesisAssessment with its own reviewer, never a field of a study appraisal.

requiredSections.purpose: The appraised study, named by exactly one cited fragment, with its design.
One table row per appraisal domain with what the study reported for it.
Limits of the appraisal: unreported items, access limits, unresolved questions.

obligationTemplates.description: The study's design, population, intervention and comparator as the study reports them.
What the study reported for one appraisal domain, attributed to the study.
How far the study's population and setting apply to the task's question.

extension: Every other report kind uses this same research-report-kind.v1 envelope. A body-of-evidence rating for an outcome/comparison/population is a separate EvidenceSynthesisAssessment over an included-study set digest, recorded with its reviewer; three reports of one study count as one origin.
